name: Supawriter
author: supawriter

sections.description:
Supawriter is an AI-powered blog CMS that generates SEO-optimized articles and publishes them directly to your WordPress site.

This plugin provides a secure connection between your Supawriter account and your WordPress site. Once connected, articles are published automatically with:

  • Full SEO metadata (works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and SEOPress)
  • Featured images
  • Categories and tags
  • Publish or draft mode

How it works:

  1. Install and activate this plugin
  2. Go to Settings → Supawriter to find your API key
  3. Enter your site URL and API key in the Supawriter dashboard
  4. Articles are published automatically when scheduled
sections.installation:
1. Upload the supawriter folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings → Supawriter to view your API key
  4. Copy the API key into your Supawriter dashboard
sections.faq:
Does this work with WordPress.com?

Yes, the plugin works on WordPress.com sites with a plan that supports plugin installation.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO (AIOSEO), and SEOPress. The plugin sets metadata for all four — whichever is active will use it.

Is my site secure?

The plugin uses a unique API key for authentication. Only requests with a valid key are accepted. You can regenerate the key at any time from Settings → Supawriter.
